Metadata.title: starter
Metadata.homeTitle: starter – Next.js SaaS starter with AI, credits and payments
Metadata.description: A Next.js SaaS starter with passwordless sign-in, credits, Stripe or Waffo payments, AI chat, images and video, an admin area, and English and Chinese.

hero.title: Everything before your first feature, done.
hero.body: Sign-in, credits, payments, AI generation and two languages are already wired up. Replace this copy with what your product does.

1.title: Sign in without passwords
1.body: Magic links by email through Resend, or one click with Google. New users get an account on first sign-in.

2.title: Credits and payments
2.body: Credit packs and monthly or yearly plans through Stripe or Waffo. Every credit change goes into a ledger the user can read.

3.title: AI chat, images and video
3.body: Chat with DeepSeek, turn prompts into images and images into videos. A failed job gives its credits back.

4.title: Notifications and admin
4.body: Users hear when a job finishes or a payment arrives. Admins manage users, orders, broadcasts and metrics.

5.title: English and 中文
5.body: Every page, title and error message ships in both languages, with a blog, a sitemap and llms.txt.

6.title: Accounts and legal pages
6.body: Users delete their own account. Privacy, terms and refund templates are linked from every footer.

1.title: Sign in
1.body: Enter your email or continue with Google. There's no password to create.

2.title: Get free credits
2.body: Every new account starts with free credits to try chat and images.

3.title: Create
3.body: Chat, generate images and turn them into videos. Buy more credits when you need them.

1.title: Do I need a password?
1.body: No. We email you a sign-in link, or you can use your Google account.

2.title: How do credits work?
2.body: Chat messages, images and seconds of video each cost credits. New accounts start with free credits. Buy a pack or subscribe on the Credits & billing page. Credits never expire, and a failed generation gives them back.

3.title: Can I delete my account?
3.body: Yes. Open your profile and choose Delete account. It's permanent and signs you out everywhere.

4.title: Which languages are supported?
4.body: English and Chinese. Switch at the top of any page; your choice is remembered.

5.title: How do I contact support?
5.body: Email <email></email>. We reply within 3 business days.

cta.title: Ready when you are.
cta.body: It takes one email to start.
